# A snow mound: a low faceted lump 1.9 x 1.2 m, 0.4 m high (half buried). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Snow --base-color 1.000 0.965 0.827 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Mound --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.6
scale 1.6 1.0 0.7
apply --scale
material assign Snow
active Mound
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export mound.glb
